articles.title: Understanding the organisation and its context
articles.requirement: The organisation shall determine external and internal issues relevant to its purpose and that affect its ability to achieve the intended outcomes of the BCMS.

articles.title: Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties
articles.requirement: The organisation shall determine the interested parties relevant to the BCMS and their requirements, including applicable legal, regulatory, and contractual obligations.

articles.title: Determining the scope of the BCMS
articles.requirement: The organisation shall determine the boundaries and applicability of the BCMS, considering internal and external issues, requirements of interested parties, and the products and services it covers.

articles.title: Business continuity management system
articles.requirement: The organisation shall establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve a BCMS, including the processes needed and their interactions, in accordance with ISO 22301.

articles.title: Leadership and commitment
articles.requirement: Top management shall demonstrate leadership and commitment by ensuring the BCMS policy and objectives are established, resources are available, and the BCMS achieves its intended outcomes.

articles.title: Policy
articles.requirement: Top management shall establish a business continuity policy appropriate to the purpose of the organisation, providing a framework for setting objectives and including a commitment to continual improvement.

articles.title: Organisational roles, responsibilities, and authorities
articles.requirement: Top management shall assign responsibilities and authorities for relevant BCMS roles, ensuring conformity with ISO 22301 and reporting on BCMS performance to top management.

articles.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
articles.requirement: The organisation shall determine risks and opportunities arising from internal/external issues and interested party requirements that need to be addressed to ensure the BCMS can achieve its intended outcomes.

articles.title: Business continuity objectives and plans to achieve them
articles.requirement: The organisation shall establish business continuity objectives at relevant functions and levels, which are measurable, monitored, communicated, and updated as appropriate.

articles.title: Planning of changes
articles.requirement: When the organisation determines the need for changes to the BCMS, the changes shall be carried out in a planned and systematic manner.

articles.title: Resources
articles.requirement: The organisation shall determine and provide the resources needed for the establishment, implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of the BCMS.

articles.title: Competence
articles.requirement: The organisation shall determine necessary competence of persons doing work that affects BCMS performance, ensure they are competent on the basis of education, training, or experience, and retain evidence.

articles.title: Awareness
articles.requirement: Persons doing work under the organisation's control shall be aware of the business continuity policy, their contribution to the BCMS, and the implications of not conforming to requirements.

articles.title: Communication
articles.requirement: The organisation shall determine internal and external communications relevant to the BCMS, including what, when, with whom, and how to communicate, and who communicates.

articles.title: Documented information
articles.requirement: The BCMS shall include documented information required by ISO 22301 and determined as necessary for BCMS effectiveness, controlled for availability, suitability, and adequate protection.

articles.title: Operational planning and control
articles.requirement: The organisation shall plan, implement, and control the processes needed to meet BCMS requirements, including managing planned changes and reviewing unintended changes.

articles.title: Business impact analysis and risk assessment
articles.requirement: The organisation shall implement and maintain a BIA process and risk assessment process that identifies prioritised activities, time frames for resumption, required resources, and impacts of disruption.

articles.title: Business continuity strategies and solutions
articles.requirement: Based on BIA and risk assessment outputs, the organisation shall identify and select business continuity strategies and solutions to protect, continue, and recover prioritised activities.

articles.title: Business continuity plans and procedures
articles.requirement: The organisation shall establish and implement business continuity plans and procedures to manage a disruptive incident, including roles, actions, communication, and recovery steps.

articles.title: Exercise and testing programme
articles.requirement: The organisation shall exercise and test its business continuity plans and procedures to ensure they are consistent with objectives, effective, and produce outcomes that are documented and reviewed.

articles.title: Evaluation of business continuity documentation and capabilities
articles.requirement: The organisation shall evaluate the business continuity documentation and capabilities at planned intervals and when significant changes occur, updating as necessary.

articles.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis, and evaluation
articles.requirement: The organisation shall determine what needs to be monitored and measured, the methods, when it shall be performed, and when results shall be analysed and evaluated.

articles.title: Internal audit
articles.requirement: The organisation shall conduct internal audits at planned intervals to determine whether the BCMS conforms to its own requirements and ISO 22301, and is effectively implemented and maintained.

articles.title: Management review
articles.requirement: Top management shall review the BCMS at planned intervals to ensure its continuing suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness, considering audit results, performance, risks, and opportunities for improvement.

articles.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
articles.requirement: When a nonconformity occurs, the organisation shall react to it, evaluate the need for corrective action to eliminate root causes, implement changes, and review the effectiveness of action taken.

articles.title: Continual improvement
articles.requirement: The organisation shall continually improve the suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness of the BCMS through the use of policy, objectives, audit results, analysis, corrective actions, and management review.
